question: CDP error/event payloads and their order for unknown toolName, invoke-after-unregister, and navigate/reload/close while an invocation is pending; adjacent: unregister-while-pending, invoke-old-name/frame after navigation.
scope: loopback 127.0.0.1 only; fresh temp profile; only this probe fixture's own tools invoked

cases.question: WebMCP.invokeTool with a name that was never registered in this frame
cases.predicateForHarness: response.ok === false && response.error.code === -32602 && response.error.message === "Tool not found" && zero WebMCP.toolInvoked/toolResponded events for this frame within 500 ms

cases.question: abort the registerTool options.signal, wait WebMCP.toolsRemoved, then invokeTool the removed name
cases.predicateForHarness: a WebMCP.toolsRemoved {name} arrives on abort; a later invokeTool for that name is a protocol error -32602 "Tool not found" with no toolInvoked/toolResponded

cases.question: invoke slow (2500 ms), then abort its registration while the invocation is pending
cases.predicateForHarness: abort of the registration does not cancel an already-started invocation: toolResponded for that invocationId arrives with status "Completed" even though toolsRemoved already fired

steps.label: abort signal for slow while pending

cases.question: invoke slowlong (10000 ms), then Page.navigate to /second while the invocation is pending
cases.predicateForHarness: navigating a frame with a pending invocation emits no toolResponded for that invocationId and no toolsRemoved for the old tool; it DOES emit Page.frameNavigated and Runtime.executionContextsCleared (in that order as observed), then toolsAdded for the new document

cases.question: after the navigation completed, invokeTool the pre-navigation tool name (and the old frameId if it differs)
cases.predicateForHarness: after navigation the old tool name is gone from that frame: -32602 "Tool not found" (no event); a pre-navigation frameId that still resolves behaves the same

cases.question: abort a tool registered with options.signal={signal} and one registered with a bare AbortSignal as the 2nd positional argument
cases.predicateForHarness: the removal signal is the `signal` property of the second (options dictionary) argument: {signal} abort -> toolsRemoved + name gone from getTools() + invokeTool -32602 "Tool not found"; a bare AbortSignal in that position is accepted but wires nothing -> no toolsRemoved, invokeTool still returns an invocationId and the tool Completes

cases.question: invoke slowlong, then Page.reload({ignoreCache:true}) while the invocation is pending
cases.predicateForHarness: reload with a pending invocation emits no toolResponded for that invocationId and no toolsRemoved; the new document re-announces its tools via toolsAdded

cases.question: invoke slowlong, then Target.closeTarget while the invocation is pending
cases.predicateForHarness: closing the target with a pending invocation emits Target.targetDestroyed (and Target.detachedFromTarget), never toolResponded for the invocationId; later commands on that session id fail with a protocol error (or time out)
